title: Rebaseline Newsletters | NHSN | CDC
content: Newsletter Articles & Archived Communications Print Minus Related Pages Return to 2022 NHSN HAI Rebaseline Landing Page Important Message: SIR and SUR reports using 2022 Rebaseline models are being added to the application in a phased approach. New educational materials are being posted to this webpage on a rolling basis as they become available. Some resources may be relevant for SIR models that are not yet available in NHSN reports. Please check back regularly for ongoing updates. 2024 2023 December December 2024 NHSN Email Blast: 2022 HAI Rebaseline Webinars [PDF – 252 KB] Sent December 4th, 2024 Inside this email – Information and registration links for the December 18th & 19th Rebaseline Webinars November November 2024 NHSN Email Blast: SIR Reports for MRSA LabID and Complex 30-day SSI Now Available [PDF – 256 KB] Sent November 22nd, 2024 Inside this email – Detailed information about how to access new reports based on 2022 HAI Rebaseline, upcoming webinar opportunities, and new training materials. November 2024 NHSN Email Blast: New SIR Reports Coming Soon [PDF – 200 KB] Sent November 18th, 2024 Inside this email – Notification about the upcoming release of the first SIR reports under the new 2022 baseline. November 2024 NHSN Email Blast: Inpatient Psychiatric Facilities (IPFs) [PDF – 202 KB] Sent November 13th, 2024 Inside this email – Information about the availability of the new 2022 Rebaseline Models for Inpatient Psychiatric Facilities, or IPFs. September September 2024 NHSN Email Blast [PDF – 206 KB] Inside this email– Links to new educational materials on the 2022 HAI Rebaseline September 2024 NHSN Newsletter Excerpt [PDF – 176 KB] Inside this Issue – Links to Slides for the August Rebaseline Webinars Additional Rebaseline Resources August August 2024 NHSN Email Blast [PDF – 225 KB] Inside this email – Announcement of upcoming Rebaseline webinars on August 20th and 21st, title “How Will My SIRs Change?” July July 2024 NHSN Email Blast [PDF – 281 KB] Inside this email- Updated Rebaseline webpage layout New Rebaseline educational materials are now available, including a Quick Learn Fact Sheet June June 2024 NHSN Newsletter Excerpt [PDF – 264 KB] Inside this issue – Links to the Rebaseline presentation from NHSN’s 2024 Annual Training Sneak peek at upcoming Rebaseline educational resources Upcoming changes to the TAP Dashboard March March 2024 NHSN Newsletter Excerpt [PDF – 103 KB] Inside this issue – Highlighting Rebaseline educational resources September September 2023 NHSN Newsletter Excerpt [PDF – 184 KB] Inside this issue – Resolving data quality issues in CDC’s national 2022 Rebaseline dataset Existing guidance and resources for users who are not familiar with the SIR or SUR metric June June 2023 NHSN Newsletter Excerpt [PDF – 110 KB] Inside this issue – Initial announcement of the 2022 HAI Rebaseline Training Newsletters / Members Meeting Updates E-mail Updates Health Department HAI/AR Programs Last Reviewed: April 2, 2025 Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention , National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) , Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP)
